post.description:
Story 1.1, after step 2: checks the date of birth and state, and stops anyone
under the age of majority before they give an email or password. Saves nothing.

Story 1.1. Emails a code to verify the address. The account is created when the code
is verified (POST /auth/verify).
Story 1.2. Signs in directly on a trusted device; otherwise emails a code.

post.description:
Checks the emailed code (after sign-up or sign-in) and signs the client in. A
sign-up's code creates the account.

Story 1.4. Signs out this device only. Send the device_token too, so the device is
forgotten even if the session already timed out. Always answers 204.
Story 1.3. Same answer whether or not the email is registered.
Lets the app show an expired or used link before the client types a new password.

Not in the 4 Nov stories (docs/PLAN.md): removes the conversation from the client's
lists straight away. After that it answers 404, like any unknown conversation.

Not in the 4 Nov stories (docs/PLAN.md): a thumbs up or down on one of the Oracle's
replies, with an optional comment. Sending it again replaces it.

Story 3.1: adds the client's message. Answers 200 with the saved message when it's a
resend.

events: "delta" pieces of text and "widget" parts, then "done" or "error". Ask again after

AcceptHealthConsent.title: AcceptHealthConsent
AcceptHealthConsent.description: The Health Consent version the client was shown and accepted.

ConversationSummary.title: ConversationSummary
ConversationSummary.description: A row in the conversation list: "Waking at 3am · 3 days ago".

DeletionRequestBody.title: DeletionRequestBody
DeletionRequestBody.description: Story 9.2: the client types the family member's first name to confirm.

FamilyMemberOut.title: FamilyMemberOut
FamilyMemberOut.description: A card on the Manage Family screen (story 9.2).

FamilyOverview.title: FamilyOverview
FamilyOverview.description:
The Manage Family screen: "2 of 3 active family members" and a card for each member,
turned-off ones included. Unfinished drafts aren't listed; Add family member resumes one.

GiveFeedback.title: GiveFeedback
GiveFeedback.description:
A thumbs up or down on one of the Oracle's replies, with an optional comment. Giving
it again replaces the earlier one.

IntakeAnswers.title: IntakeAnswers
IntakeAnswers.description:
The answer to one intake step. Send only that step's fields. The Back button changes
an earlier answer by sending it again. Family-only fields are refused on the client's own
profile.

MeOut.title: MeOut
MeOut.description:
What the app needs before the policy gate (/me answers before updated policies are
accepted). The date of birth and state are personal data, so they're left out
here; story 11.1 will show them behind the gate.

ProfileDetails.title: ProfileDetails
ProfileDetails.description: A profile's details for View & edit (story 9.2).

ProfileEdit.title: ProfileEdit
ProfileEdit.description:
View & edit a family member (story 9.2). Send the fields to change; the app may also send
the whole form.

- A write-in can be sent on its own while the saved choice is "Other".
- Changing the relationship needs the advocate consent again, in the same request (story
  2.2's step 4), so the consent always matches who the member is to the client.
- Date of birth and sex at birth are read-only: accepted unchanged, refused if different.

SendMessage.title: SendMessage
SendMessage.description:
A client message. The app makes `client_msg_id` (a UUID) once per message and sends it
again with any retry, so a message is never saved twice. Symptoms ticked in the symptom
check arrive as part of the text. A tapped answer sends its label as the text, and what
was tapped as `answer` (see Answer in app/oracle/contract.py).

SignUpCheck.title: SignUpCheck
SignUpCheck.description:
The body of POST /auth/signup/check. Other sign-up fields the app sends with it (the
first name from step 1, say) are ignored, so the app can send the form as it stands.

VerificationRequired.title: VerificationRequired
VerificationRequired.description: The next screen is the Verification screen: a code was emailed.
